verdict.rationale: Oneleet's own docs say customers can set up and publish a customizable Trust Center and link it from their landing page, so a hosted public trust center exists. Nothing describes what it contains or how access is gated. Missing for 10: live control status display, certification listing, report sharing under click-through NDA, evidence that it shortens security reviews, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start

citations.quote: Once onboarded to the Oneleet platform, set up and publish your customizable Trust Center. You can add a link to the Trust Center on your Landing Page
You can add a link to the Trust Center on your Landing Page to show your ongoing commitment to security.
